text:
alex.r: Heads-up: customer BrightArc reporting spikes of 500s on API + missing audit entries for their retention window (2026-03-15T10:00-10:30Z). Opening INC-2026-042, P2. Is KMS/HSM a likely vector here?

sam.t: Do we have logs that show 'decrypt failed' or any KMS error around those timestamps? Could be transient key access issue.

maria.p: I see a scheduled KMS rotation event at ~10:05 for the region that serves BrightArc, but rotation was tagged as a config-only rotation (no material deletion). Pulling HSM attestation and audit ingestion metrics now.

ben.k: If audit entries are missing for that exact window, runbook: check (1) KMS admin ops, (2) HSM export logs, (3) audit ingestion/backfill queue. Also check retention TTL on audit_events table — last change to retention was in Jan.

opsbot: Incident created: INC-2026-042 | priority=P2 | services affected: api-gateway, audit-ingest, kms-service.

alex.r: Customer asks: were any keys deleted or rewrapped? they want a timeline and confirmation of data integrity before we send a comms update.

maria.p: Quick repro I ran against staging that reproduced 500s briefly:
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-7b","input":"hello"}'
```
Response was 500 with log: `2026-03-15T10:12:03Z ERROR serve req=abcd1234 status=500 err=kv_decrypt_failed key_id=projects/redwood/locations/us/keyR`

sam.t: We also got a billing-reconcile alert around 10:30 for increased error rate; could be related but might be a downstream symptom.

ben.k: I'm pulling CloudKMS admin audit logs and HSM attestation. If an operator invoked a rotate, it's recorded with admin principal. Also checking if any policy change hit retention TTL for audit_events.

maria.p: Preliminary: KMS admin rotate shows one operator action at 2026-03-15T10:04:55Z labeled "rotation-trigger". The rotate completed with status=OK. HSM export logs show no exports. BUT the audit-ingest consumer lag spiked 10:07->10:20 and then drained — ingestion pipeline backlog would make entries appear delayed/missing in the UI during that window.

alex.r: Good catch. So likely root cause is ingestion backlog + transient decrypt error during rotation. Customer wants an EOD comms. Proposed comms bullets: (1) confirm no keys deleted; (2) provide exact timeline of KMS rotation and HSM attestations; (3) explain audit ingestion backlog and backfill plan; (4) offer raw exported logs + attestation. Thoughts? @ben.k @maria.p

ben.k: Agree with those bullets. I'll prepare a formal attestation doc: "No key material deleted; rotation completed successfully; HSM attestation attached; audit ingestion backlog caused temporary visibility gap."

sam.t: Ops: can the ingestion backfill reconstruct the missing audit entries and verify integrity against raw buffer? If so include ETA in comms.

maria.p: Yes, backfill can reconstruct from persistent buffer. Starting backfill job now targeting BrightArc tenant only. ETA to validate+publish timeline: ~3 hours. If backfill fails I'll update immediately.

alex.r: :thumbsup: I'll draft the customer message and ping legal for wording. Keep me posted if anything changes about key deletion status.

opsbot: Incident INC-2026-042 status -> investigation in progress; assignees: maria.p, ben.k, sam.t.

oncall-ir: Security note: attaching HSM attestation PDF and initial KMS audit extract to the incident ticket once ready. Will also timestamp the report for compliance requests.

alex.r: Thanks — once backfill completes we'll include the CSV export and attestation in the customer deliverable.

maria.p: Backfill started at 2026-03-15T11:02:00Z, job id bf-21725-01. Monitoring progress.

ben.k: Draft attestation will be ready in ~45m, attaching to INC ticket when done.

alex.r: OK — planning customer update in 3 hours unless we get new info.

opsbot: Incident INC-2026-042 last updated 2172501520 by opsbot: backfill running.
